The '''Tomato''' is a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] [[Crops|crop]] that grows from [[Tomato Seeds]] after 11 days and continues to produce every 4 days after maturity.

==Stages==
When harvested, each Tomato plant gives 1 Tomato every 4 days, with a 5% chance for more Tomatoes.

==Tailoring==
Tomato is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Tomato Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt282.png|24px]]  It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
The Tomato may be randomly requested in [[Summer]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|180}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.

==Trivia==
The ambiguous status of the tomato - fruit or vegetable - is the subject of the argument in [[Demetrius]]' Six Hearts event. For this reason, the Tomato Shirt appears to be a combination of his and [[Robin]]'s shirts.
